reviews.summary: HOT is in a just-launched migration regime: HoloFuel and the HOT swap opened November 1, 2026. New bridge/swap, provisional licensing, and launch-related fraud/operational uncertainty materially elevate contextual risk for HOT now.
materialRisks: Major live event: HOT-to-HoloFuel bridging and voluntary 1:1 swapping began November 1, 2026, changing the asset’s operating context during the signal window.
The swap operator’s Zanzibar license is provisional for 90 days; its terms allow bridge/swap suspension for security, legal, or regulatory reasons.
Holo reports an active surge in impersonation/counterfeit-swap scams around the launch, creating heightened wallet/transaction-security risk for participants.

facts.fact: Holo Limited assigned the HOT redemption mechanism to Net Zero FZC on November 1, 2026; HoloFuel Network and the swap are live. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/resources/schedule1notice))

Official terms state the license is provisional for 90 days from November 1, 2026 and may be amended, suspended, revoked, or not renewed; bridge/swap operations may be suspended for security, legal, or regulatory reasons. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html))

HOT is not being retired or burned: it retains exchange trading pairs; bridging locks HOT and a completed swap to HoloFuel is irreversible except for specified earned-HoloFuel conditions. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html))

Holo’s October 29 safety notice says it is already receiving reports of team impersonation and counterfeit swap sites tied to the launch. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/resources/safety-reminders-holofuel-launch-hot-swap/))
